A '''starship captain''' served on the bridge of a [[Consular ship/Legends|consular ship]] under the command of [[Ambassador/Legends|Ambassador]] [[Zell]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Majoor]] during a [[Peace mission to Armath|peace mission]] to the planet [[Armath]]. When the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Reddjak]] attacked the convoy, the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] joined the ambassador in boarding the pirates' [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the ''[[Blood Brother]]'', to thwart the outlaw's plans and to rescue Zell's kidnapped son, [[Llez]].
